product_one_liner.value: RedTeam provides construction management software for small and mid-sized commercial general contractors to manage projects, financials, documents, and team coordination in one platform.
product_one_liner.notes: The homepage directly identifies small and mid-sized commercial general contractors as its audience and projects, financials, documents, and team coordination as its functions. Source: https://redteam.com/

pricing_page.notes: The public pricing page explains Active Project Value pricing, an annual-price calculator for smaller tiers, and custom quotes for larger accounts. Source: https://redteam.com/pricing

named_customers.notes: named_customers: The homepage presents customer testimonials attributed to T&G Constructors and ASI General Contractors, with case-study links. Source: https://redteam.com/ | named_customers.0: The homepage attributes a customer testimonial to Julio Claussen, Project Manager at T&G Constructors. Source: https://redteam.com/ | named_customers.1: The homepage attributes a customer testimonial to Joel Anzelc, Vice President at ASI General Contractors. Source: https://redteam.com/

employee_band.notes: The company profile lists 98 employees, while LeadIQ reports approximately 99 as of August 2026; both fall within 51–100. Other directory estimates differ, so the band is not treated as certain. Sources: https://linkedin.com/company/redteamsoftware and https://leadiq.com/c/redteam---construction-technology/5a1da3502300005e009569a6

hq_location.notes: hq_city: RedTeam’s company history explicitly identifies its headquarters as Orlando, Florida. Source: https://redteam.com/about-us | hq_country: RedTeam’s history identifies its headquarters as Orlando, Florida, and its company profile explicitly identifies the country as United States. Sources: https://redteam.com/about-us and https://linkedin.com/company/redteamsoftware

founded_year.notes: RedTeam’s company history explicitly places its founding by Michael Wright in 2006. Source: https://redteam.com/about-us

eng_blog.notes: The Builder Blog and resources index show construction advice, buyer guides, procurement guidance, and contract explainers rather than two engineer-authored posts explaining how RedTeam itself is built. Sources: https://blog.redteam.com/ and https://redteam.com/resources/release-notes

public_docs.notes: The public help center lists substantial documentation collections, including 133 Fieldlens articles, 501 RedTeam Go articles, and 236 RedTeam Flex articles. Source: https://help.redteam.com/en

ai_ml_roles_open.notes: The official job index explicitly states that no jobs are posted. A separately accessible live posting is for Revenue Operations Manager, which does not qualify. The index and direct postings have inconsistent availability signals, limiting confidence in the negative. Sources: https://redteam.apscareerportal.com/jobs?locale=en-US and https://redteam.apscareerportal.com/jobs/3672234/apps/new

model_provider.value: Amazon Web Services — Amazon Bedrock and Amazon Textract
model_provider.notes: Allata’s RedTeam client case study explicitly identifies an AWS Bedrock and Textract pipeline and includes attribution to RedTeam’s CTO. It does not name a specific foundation model. Source: https://www.allata.com/client-stories/redteam-harnesses-aws-and-generative-ai-to-achieve-90-extraction-accuracy-and-supercharge-document-processing

compliance_certs.notes: The privacy policy, including its confidentiality and security section, names none of SOC 2, ISO 27001, HIPAA, GDPR, or PCI DSS. The empty list represents no qualifying claims on that legal page, not a finding that RedTeam lacks certifications. Source: https://redteam.com/privacy-policies

last_funding.notes: funding_stage: The funding profile explicitly labels the latest recorded financing as Series B. Source: https://tracxn.com/d/companies/redteam-software/__8uqjtcWi34fjq7b-F-SIGADWn7r4JGxDBWH1cz8DPDU | funding_date: The latest recorded funding date is February 2, 2022, normalized to the requested YYYY-MM format. Source: https://tracxn.com/d/companies/redteam-software/__8uqjtcWi34fjq7b-F-SIGADWn7r4JGxDBWH1cz8DPDU | funding_amount_usd: The funding profile identifies the latest round amount as USD 28,000,000. Source: https://tracxn.com/d/companies/redteam-software/__8uqjtcWi34fjq7b-F-SIGADWn7r4JGxDBWH1cz8DPDU

raised_18mo.notes: The latest recorded round is February 2022, before the May 2025 cutoff. Investor counsel’s dated announcement independently confirms the investment that month. Sources: https://tracxn.com/d/companies/redteam-software/__8uqjtcWi34fjq7b-F-SIGADWn7r4JGxDBWH1cz8DPDU and https://www.kirkland.com/news/press-release/2022/02/kirkland-advises-braemont-capital-and-jettycove

hiring_sdr_ae.notes: A directly accessible Account Executive – SMB posting includes an application form. Confidence is limited because the aggregate job index reports no openings despite accessible individual postings. Source: https://redteam.careerplug.com/jobs/3327123/apps/new

launched_6mo.notes: An August 19, 2026 article presents a rebuilt Submittals experience, available in beta, replacing the legacy tool with new setup and responsibility-tracking workflows. This is treated as a major-feature beta announcement within the six-month window, not a general-availability launch. Source: https://blog.redteam.com/new-submittals-experience-redteam-flex

leadership_change_12mo.notes: RedTeam announced Connor Schone’s appointment as Vice President of Finance on July 9, 2026, within the requested 12-month window. Source: https://www.globenewswire.com/news-release/2026/07/09/3324998/0/en/RedTeam-Appoints-Connor-Schone-as-Vice-President-of-Finance.html
